references.text: Moses also prays here to the Lord not to destroy his people, using similar words about the people as God's inheritance and about deliverance from Egypt
Moses intercedes for the people and reminds God of His power when He led them out of Egypt
Describes how the Lord redeemed Israel with a mighty hand and great judgments
Refers to how the Lord freed Israel from the house of bondage in Egypt with a strong hand
The psalmist asks God to remember His congregation, which He has redeemed, His inheritance tribe
Refers to Moses who stood in the breach for God to turn away His wrath from destroying the people
Describes the people whom the Lord has redeemed and led by His mercy to His holy dwelling
Refers to Israel as God's chosen people whom He brought out of Egypt
Solomon describes Israel as God's people and inheritance whom He brought out of Egypt
Nehemiah prays to God and refers to the people as God's servants whom He redeemed with His great power and strong hand
